name: generic-codex-workbench
description: Closed-loop harness workbench for Codex with lane-centric skills, attached current-thread control, and resumable file-backed runtime state.

interface.shortDescription: Lane-centric closed-loop harness for Codex app workflows
interface.longDescription: Use the generic Codex workbench to route harness work, run attached current-thread loops, inspect resumable runs, and keep operator-facing state honest across current-thread, app-server, and headless transports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Before handling a product-build request, verify packages/loop-orchestrator/dist exists. If it is missing, run bash ./init.sh once before asking product questions. Then route app/product/dashboard/tool/service/agent requests through app-builder-loop. Discovery must ask only missing high-impact questions, prepare runtime artifacts at ready_for_prepare, stop at ready_to_start, and start the closed loop only after the user explicitly says '루프 시작' or 'start loop'. Use loop-control for start/status/resume/stop, and run attached loops from the current Codex thread without nested exec calls.
